data.name: Prohibition Panic!
data.detailed_description:
Prohibition Panic!...

... is an online, co-op party game for up to 4 players. Restore a faded Prohibition speakeasy to its former glory while dodging the law and its breakers.

Keep the Fun Flowing!

Welcome to the American Prohibition, an era where the 'juice' flows freely and debauchery runs rampant. The party goes until daylight in your speakeasy. Mix, pour, and prepare all kinds of prohibited concoctions for your customers, while making sure they don't push their limits.

What's the Password?

'The more, the merrier' only goes so far - you'll need to vet all of your potential patrons to make sure only the savory-est of the unsavory are entering your establishment. Police informants, troublemakers, and otherwise normal patrons who have indulged a little too much would be best shown the exit.

All Kinds of Ways to Play!

Prohibition Panic! features 4 modes, each designed to challenge you (and your potential speakeasy co-owners) in all kinds of wacky ways.

  • Rags to Racketeers: learn to play Prohibition Panic!, as you restore a faded speakeasy to its former glory while navigating the bootleg underworld of the American Prohibition.

  • Rum Run: how long will your speakeasy survive when every night, a new opportunity (or a new challenge) appears? Being raided by the cops means the end of your run with the speakeasy, meaning careful coordination and decision making with your friends is the key to Rum Runner glory.

  • Open Bar: pour, serve, bounce, and slap to your heart's content in a speakeasy where money is no object. In this mode, time is on your side, and your customers will happily await your concoctions with all the patience in the world.

  • Tap Trials: compete with other individuals and groups in the world to top the leaderboards in wacky timed challenge rounds. Climb your way to underground notoriety in the face of the law!
